Week 15, August 12, 2026 in Ocala

Week 15-- The Plot Actually Thickens

This was the last week of the transfer! Tomorrow I go to Tampa...

a- to pick up my MTC companion, Sister Nelson! Then we're heading back to Ocala

b- to meet my new companion, Sister Robison! Then we're whitewashing our new area, St. Pete, while Elders replace my old area.

c- with Sister George and Sister Frey to drop them off and pick up three other Sisters, including a brand new missionary!! She's going to be trained by Sister Smith, and Sister Brushkey will be my new companion ♥️

d- I'm not going to Tampa because my new companion is Sister Frey (yay!) and she lives in the same apartment complex as me. We're spending transfer time tomorrow helping her move into my room.

Quick, email me back with your guess! Unless you're a missionary and today isn't your p-day. In that case, write down which one you think it is and plan to email me back on your p-day. Only after you have done either of these things can you move on. I expect many emails at this point. Stay tuned for the answer...

Thursday, 08/06 We had another lesson with Elizabeth! She is literally the best I love her so much!! See my previous email for more on her ❤️

Friday, 08/07 We had a great lesson with Caleb. He doesn't have a car, so on Thursday we asked if there was a good time for someone to drop him off at the church. He said yes, let's do tomorrow at 4pm. Surprise, surprise, we couldn't find a woman to join our lesson at such short notice. However, there is a stake volleyball night every Friday that Caleb goes to, so we stole a sister there to join our lesson.

Saturday, 08/08 Sister Crowther's last 5k! It was so much fun, I truly love the people that come and the time I've spent running with them.

Guys, knocking works! The Hermanas sent us a message saying that someone at their soccer night showed them a video from their ring doorbell of Sister Crowther and I leaving a message and a note on their door! He was interested in learning more because where are all these missionaries coming from??

Sunday, 08/09 SO MANY PEOPLE CAME TO CHURCH!!! Lovie and her three adorable daughters came! We sat next to them during the first hour and oh my goodness her kids are so cute!! LaShandra and her whole crew came, too! She's an inactive member we've been meeting with, and every time we come over her desire to come back to church and to follow Jesus Christ grows stronger. I love her and her family so much!! Arthur and Jeremiah came too, and so did all of Joel's family!

Monday, 08/10 We had a good church tour lesson with Robert! He was a little over half an hour late, so our poor MPL got there at 6:30 and left at 7:40 😅 But she shared a beautiful testimony and the Spirit was so strong! And we got to know her really well while we were waiting. She's awesome!

Tuesday, 08/11 We made four friends on Tuesday! Unfortunately, one of them texted back that she was no longer interested -

We dropped Sister Crowther off forever Tuesday night 😢 😭

Wednesday, 08/12 I'm in a trio with Sister George and Sister Frey again!! We got transfer news at 8:15 am this morning, which is 3.5 hours better than last time!

Speaking of transfer news, you might be wondering what mine is! I should hope so, it's quite suspenseful. The answer is... (drumroll, please) that you get to find out next week! I'd tell you now, but I needed to make sure that you wouldn't cheat and look at the answer before emailing me back. If you get it right, you earn 1000 brownie points, and if you don't email me back, you lose 1000 brownie points. So the stakes are pretty high!

Spiritual thought Ether 12-4 Wherefore, whoso believeth in God might with surety hope for a better world, yea, even a place at the right hand of God, which hope cometh of faith, maketh an anchor to the souls of men, which would make them sure and steadfast, always abounding in good works, being led to glorify God.

I know that when Jesus Christ is your anchor, He will help you. You have to go through hard things-- you can do them alone or with Christ, and He will ease your burdens.

I will close for now and pray that you don’t get eaten by a bear before you have a chance to respond, Sister Christison
